name: MathVista
intro: MathVista 是一个系统评测视觉情境数学推理的多模态基准，包含来自 28 个既有数据集和 IQTest、FunctionQA、PaperQA 三个新数据集的 6,141 道题，覆盖五类任务与七类数学推理能力。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: 多源数据汇集、人工标注、格式标准化
language: 英文, 中文, 波斯语
task_type: 视觉问答, 数学推理
eval_feature: 五类任务, 七类推理, 三阶段答案抽取与规范化
build_method_en: Multi-source aggregation, human annotation, format standardization
eval_feature_en: Five tasks, seven reasoning types, three-stage answer extraction and normalization
intro_en: MathVista is a multimodal benchmark for systematically evaluating mathematical reasoning in visual contexts. Its 6,141 problems come from 28 existing datasets plus three new sets—IQTest, FunctionQA, and PaperQA—and cover five tasks and seven mathematical reasoning skills.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.02255 and the official lupantech/MathVista repository. The diagram preserves the 28 existing sources split into nine math-targeted QA and 19 general VQA datasets, the three new IQTest/FunctionQA/PaperQA sources, 6,141 total items, five tasks, seven reasoning skills, record-level metadata and answer contracts, the disjoint 1,000-item testmini plus 5,141-item hidden-label test split, type-aware response generation, GPT-4 answer extraction validated above 99.5% on 200 examples, official choice/integer/float/list normalization, deterministic correctness, and fine-grained accuracy reporting.
